items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: when I first started I'd rather work with Paul Bones than any of them... I'd rather work with him in a good piano

ctx.x: Yeah, he'd hit chords on the beat and so on.

A saxophone player, I mean, when I first started I'd rather work with Paul Bones than any of them. That's what I'm telling you, at his time, I mean. At his time, I mean, I'd rather work with him in a good piano. He'd play some ball in his time. Yeah, he was a good saxophone player, I mean. If that I'd point out to you, he was alright, but I'd rather Paul style.
Are there any other clarinet players you liked besides Piku?
